subject: Re: CloudBridge private offer — commission / pass-through clarification
messages:
From: CloudBridge Sales <sales@cloudbridge.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: CloudBridge private offer for Redwood (GCP)

Hi Irene / Vanessa,

Thanks for the productive conversation earlier. Per our notes, attached is a draft private offer for Redwood on GCP covering our CloudBridge managed SKU bundle (compute + storage + mgmt). Key commercial terms in the draft:
- Year 1 list discount: 18% off published MSRP for the bundled SKU
- Channel commission: 10% of net revenue payable to Redwood as a commission 
- Initial commitment: 12 months, $350k minimum first-year ARR
- SKU mapping and billing will be via a single CloudBridge GCP SKU (we will provide CSV mapping)

Questions from our side: how do you prefer the commission flow to show on your side (line item pass-through vs. separate rebate)? Also, if Redwood wants to re-sell to end customers as a reseller under your account, let us know the preferred billing flow so we can configure the private offer accordingly.

I've attached the draft contract/PO for reference (CloudBridge_PO_Draft_v2.pdf). If you can confirm the desired commission pass-through approach and any minimum guaranteed pass-through percentage, we can send an updated PO and a DocuSign link.

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Enterprise Sales, CloudBridge
attachments: CloudBridge_PO_Draft_v2.pdf
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: CloudBridge Sales <sales@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CloudBridge private offer for Redwood (GCP)

Samir — thanks for the note and the draft. Quick clarifications from our side before we escalate internally:

1) Commission pass-through mechanics
- Does the 10% you noted get included as a discount line on the private offer (visible to end customers), or is it handled as an off-invoice rebate from CloudBridge to Redwood? We prefer the discount-line approach for transparency and for reporting on our end, but can consider rebate if necessary.

2) Marketplace/reseller model
- We need to confirm whether Redwood will appear as the reseller on the invoice or if CloudBridge will remain the billing entity and process a commission to us. Some of our downstream customers require the reseller invoice for procurement/audit purposes.

3) Commission flexibility and tiering
- For this deal, our standard expectation is a 12–15% channel pass-through to our resale partners. Can CloudBridge stretch to 12% guaranteed for year 1 with an ability to move to 14% if we commit to 18 months and >= $500k ARR?

4) SKU mapping and list price basis
- Please include the SKU CSV and confirm whether the 18% discount is off your published GCP listing price (preferred) or off an internal list. Also confirm whether marketplace fees (GCP listing fees) are accounted for before/after the discount.

Next steps: if you can respond to the above, we'll align with Legal/Finance and propose a 30-minute call early next week to finalize. Adding Karthik and Marcus to keep Marketplace and Finance in the loop.

Best,
Irene Choi
Sr. Manager, Strategic GTM — Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: CloudBridge Sales <sales@cloudbridge.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CloudBridge private offer for Redwood (GCP)

Hi Irene / team — thanks for the clear list. Answers inline and next steps below.

On Wed, Nov 4, 2026 at 11:03 AM Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com> wrote:
> 1) Commission pass-through mechanics
> - Does the 10% you noted get included as a discount line on the private offer (visible to end customers), or is it handled as an off-invoice rebate from CloudBridge to Redwood?

Good question — we can do either technically, but the default for our marketplace ops is to configure the private offer with an explicit discount line so the reseller receives the reduced price at checkout and the commission is visible in the invoice/usage report. That said, for some legacy reseller arrangements we have a post-invoice rebate flow. For Redwood, we'll plan to set it as a discount line unless you ask otherwise.

> 2) Marketplace/reseller model
> - We need to confirm whether Redwood will appear as the reseller on the invoice or if CloudBridge will remain the billing entity and process a commission to us.

We will keep CloudBridge as the billing party for the private offer (this simplifies billing reconciliation on our side) but the invoice will include a line showing the reseller discount. If your customers require reseller invoicing (where Redwood is the legal seller), that's a different configuration and we'd need to scope ingestion + reseller onboarding with Marketplace (longer lead time).

> 3) Commission flexibility and tiering
> - Can CloudBridge stretch to 12% guaranteed for year 1 with an ability to move to 14% if we commit to 18 months and >= $500k ARR?

We can agree to a 12% guaranteed pass-through for year 1. We can escalate to 14% if Redwood commits to 18 months and a $500k ARR threshold — we would reflect that in the PO as a tier with a usage verification clause.

> 4) SKU mapping and list price basis
> - Please include the SKU CSV and confirm whether the 18% discount is off your published GCP listing price...

We'll send the SKU mapping CSV in the next email. The 18% is off our published GCP listing price; marketplace fees are applied after discounts in our current setup, so end-customer effective price will reflect the discount first.

Next steps: attaching updated PO that sets the commission as a 12% discount-line for year 1 and includes the escalation clause to 14% on the 18-month / $500k ARR commit. DocuSign link will follow once you confirm.

Attachments: CloudBridge_PO_Draft_v2_updated.pdf
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/link/CB-PO-9874

Regards,
Samir Patel
Enterprise Sales, CloudBridge
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: CloudBridge Sales <sales@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 14:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CloudBridge private offer for Redwood (GCP) — next steps

Samir — appreciate the quick turnaround and flexibility. We are broadly aligned on the mechanics. Confirming our ask so your team can produce an updated PO / DocuSign: 
- Year 1: 18% off published listing price
- Channel pass-through: 12% guaranteed (discount-line on the private offer)
- Escalation: to 14% if Redwood commits 18 months and >= $500k ARR (verification clause)
- Billing: CloudBridge remains billing party; invoice will include discount line item.

I've attached our internal pricing workbook (redwood-private-pricing-workbook.xlsx) with the modeling assumption we will use to validate net economics. Please route the PO to our Legal (legal@redwood.com) after you incorporate the above, and we'll triage redlines quickly.

I'll schedule a 30-minute call with Marketplace + Finance for Wednesday morning PT to finalize. Thanks — looping Vanessa and Karthik for any final notes.

Best,
Irene Choi
Sr. Manager, Strategic GTM — Marketplace Partnerships
